Giving back in Hilton Head & Bluffton

Tio's Community Table

Pull Up a Chair. Give Back Here.

At Tio's, giving back isn't a once-a-year event. It's built into our table, every single month. Through our Community Table, our Hilton Head and Bluffton restaurants partner with local nonprofits and community initiatives all year long, turning the food and drinks our guests already love into real support for the neighbors who need it most.

Start Your ApplicationHow It Works

Community Impact

  • 24local partners supported each year
  • 2locations giving every month
  • 10%of feature-item sales donated to partners
  • $500minimum guaranteed per partner, per month
How It Works

One Partner, One Month, Every Location

Each month, each Tio's location features one local partner. All month long, Tio's donates 10% of net sales from our Monthly Margarita Feature and our Give Back Burrito to that partner, with a $500 minimum guaranteed.

Partners are selected through a simple application and a community-minded review, so the calendar reflects the causes Hilton Head Island and Bluffton care about most.

  1. ApplyTell us about your organization and the neighbors you serve.
  2. Get your monthYour partner month is set at our Hilton Head or Bluffton location.
  3. Guests dine, you receive10% of feature-item sales, with $500 guaranteed, paid within 30 days of month-end.
For partners

What Your Organization Receives

  • A real donation. 10% of feature-item sales for your month, $500 minimum guaranteed, paid within 30 days of month-end.
  • A month in the spotlight. Your organization featured in our dining rooms at our Hilton Head or Bluffton location.
  • New faces at your table. Our guests discover your mission, and many become your supporters, donors and volunteers.
  • Marketing done with you. Custom graphics, table tents, a QR link to your story, and 3 to 4 social posts during your month.
  • An Impact Snapshot. A one-page report of what your month raised and the story it tells, yours to reuse anywhere.
Our partnership

What We Ask of Partners

  • Show up. At least one Community Table Kickoff Night at your location, with 2 ambassadors for about 90 minutes.
  • Spread the word. 2 social posts and 1 email or newsletter to your supporters during your month.
  • Bring your crew. Invite your board, volunteers and friends to dine at Tio's during your month.
  • Share your story. A logo, 1 to 2 photos, a short blurb and an impact story we can share (assets due 2 weeks before your month).
  • Paperwork. A completed W-9 (or fiscal sponsor letter) so we can pay your donation promptly.
Every visit counts

Round Up at Checkout

Give a little more while you dine.

Asked for a Gift Card, Basket or Donation?

We get requests almost every day, and we'd love to say yes to everyone.

Community Table is how we make our giving count: instead of one-off items, we invest a full month of fundraising, marketing and guest traffic in each partner we select.

If your organization serves Hilton Head Island or Bluffton, the best way to partner with Tio's is to apply.

2027 Partner Application

Each month of 2027, each Tio's location (Shelter Cove on Hilton Head Island, and Bluffton) will feature one local partner and donate 10% of net sales from the Monthly Margarita Feature and Give Back Burrito, with a $500 minimum guaranteed per partner month, paid within 30 days of month-end. 24 partners will be selected for 2027 (12 per location). Applications close December 15, 2026, 11:59 pm ET. Selections are notified beginning December 22, 2026.
